enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Remain still. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back over body. Turn to back. Snore. Move right arm. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Open eyes at 06:30.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off water heater. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place eggs on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs with fork. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour egg mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Slide eggs onto plate. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait. Toaster pops. Take bread. Spread butter on bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs and toast. Drink milk. Clear dishes. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Lay clothes on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to mirror. Check reflection. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place wallet inside. Place phone inside. Close bag. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Look at watch. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Greet colleague. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock. Enter. Say 'Good morning' to patient. Check vital signs. Listen to heart and lungs. Check blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient. Take lunch break. Eat sandwich. Attend meeting. Write notes. Use computer. Talk to doctor. End shift.
Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pot. Cut vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir. Add chicken. Stir. Add spices. Cover pot. Wait. Turn off cooker. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Place dishes in rack.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Press channel button. Watch news. Press volume up. Watch show. Press channel button. Watch movie. Check phone. Press pause. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Return. Sit. Press play. Continue watching. Press power. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Type password. Open browser. Check email. Reply to email. Open document. Type report. Save document. Open social media. Scroll. Watch video. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash toothbrush. Place toothbrush in holder. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up book from nightstand. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Put book down. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open reading app. Read article. Scroll. Open social media. Scroll. Watch video. Close app. Lock phone. Place phone on nightstand. Pick up book again. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out pajamas. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Wash hands. Return to bedroom. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Remain still.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Sleep.
